summary: The Temporal Maelstrom Dungeon is the collapse nexus of Fractured Time. Overlapping timelines, paradoxes, and echoes manifest physically. Collapse threatens to undo reality itself.
history: Formed when Fractured Time collapsed inward.
Temporal instability spread outward, creating loops and echoes.
Void breaches opened, linking Discord to cosmic emptiness.
Chrono‑Titan arose as embodiment of collapse.
